text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
I'm sorry... Even after you warned me so 
many times to be careful not to get 
hurt...
choice_data_list: I wasn't paying enough attention either...

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
If something like this happens, I'll just 
end up making the bodyguards worry 
again...

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
...No. Maybe at a time like this, I should 
show them I can still move to put their 
minds at ease.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
It'll serve as rehab too. What do you 
think, Trainer...?
choice_data_list:
...Make sure not to push yourself too 
hard, okay?

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
It'll serve as rehab too. What do you 
think, Trainer...?
choice_data_list:
...Make sure not to push yourself too 
hard, okay?

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
“Still... if she told me, ‘I can't run in 
races anymore...’...”

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Even so, I can't let her do anything 
dangerous. Besides, I told her that 
pushing herself to move would only do the 
opposite of putting those around her at 
ease...

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
! ...You're definitely right. I guess I 
was rushing things a little.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Thanks for stopping me. I ended up showing 
you an embarrassing side of myself...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Wearing a smile that seemed faintly 
sorrowful, Fine Motion went into 
recuperation.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: Yes, of course...

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: Ugh...!

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Ngh... Excuse me... I'm all right. Though 
if it hurts from just this much, I still 
have a long way to go...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
As long as she rests properly and heals 
up, there shouldn't be a problem. I told 
the guards that I would explain everything 
to reassure them, so they wouldn't 
worry...

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
"...I'm sorry. I caused trouble for you 
again, didn't I...?"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Fine Motion grew quiet, as if swallowing a 
sigh.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: Yes! It's okay, believe in me.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
“—How was that? You handled it without a 
problem, right? It's much safer here than 
running outdoors, after all.”

text_block_list.name: Bodyguard Captain
choice_data_list:
If it hurts even in the slightest, we're 
switching to classroom study.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Waah, that's a great idea♪ Let's do some 
mental training and stuff!

text_block_list.name: Bodyguard Captain
text_block_list.text:
Phew... I fully understand your 
enthusiasm, both of you. However, please 
make sure not to let your guard down.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: Ngh...! Thank you so much...!

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Alright Trainer, let's do our best with 
reasonable training, okay?♪ Ei-ei-oh!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Fine Motion gives a sparkling smile. I 
need to come up with a new training menu 
right away...!
